purpose: Reader-safe template for educational public-address whale-watch reports on Bionic Banker.
privacy_boundary: Use public addresses and explorer links only. Do not include private wallet data, client data, account data, seed phrases, private keys, or instructions to copy a trade.
publishing_cadence: Daily or biweekly after the watched-address list is source-reviewed.
aml_connection: Public blockchain rows can feed the AML learning layer as source records: address label, transaction source, movement type, pattern flags, missing context, and human-review question.
allowed_actions: Document public wallet movements as educational reports
Link to public blockchain explorers and public label sources
Record movement type, timing, size band, direction, and missing context
Connect recurring public patterns to AML review questions
blocked_actions: No trading advice or copy-trading instruction
No fund movement, wallet control, or account registration
No external submissions or third-party account actions
No accusation, filing decision, KYC approval, or compliance verdict

report_fields.purpose: The public wallet, entity label, or watch-list name. Use a public label/source when available.
The public blockchain where the movement was observed.
Explorer, public label page, dashboard, or community-maintained public watch list.
Asset, amount band, transaction type, exchange in/out, bridge, swap, consolidation, or distribution.
When the row was observed and whether it relates to nearby market/news context.
Why the address or behavior is notable in public-market culture.
The human question this public row would raise inside a bounded review workflow.
What the row cannot know: intent, ownership, off-chain reason, customer identity, or full history.
The report is context only, not advice, accusation, or a compliance decision.

sample_record.title: Sample public-wallet watch row
sample_record.address_or_label: Community-known whale wallet or public entity label
sample_record.public_source: Public explorer and public label source
sample_record.what_moved: Large exchange deposit or withdrawal, size band only until source-reviewed
sample_record.timing: Observed near a market move or news window
sample_record.why_people_watch: Large public wallets can show behavior that traders discuss, but the movement does not reveal intent by itself.
sample_record.aml_review_question: Does the surrounding activity repeat a routing, exchange, bridge, mixer, or consolidation pattern that deserves slower human review?
sample_record.missing_context: Owner intent, private identity, off-chain reason, complete transaction history, and whether the movement relates to a trade.
sample_record.clear_limit: Educational public-address context only. Do not copy a trade, accuse a wallet, move funds, or treat this as a filing decision.

source_review_rule: A watched source is publishable only when the public label/source can be cited and the source trail keeps intent, ownership, identity, and trading meaning unresolved.

watchlist_review_queue.source_class: public explorer label or official public disclosure
watchlist_review_queue.why_watch: Shows how known public treasury-style wallets can create market questions without revealing private intent.
watchlist_review_queue.report_use: Used for Report 003 as a first cited explorer-label example: source first, movement category second, no market meaning.

watchlist_review_queue.label: Exchange hot wallet label
watchlist_review_queue.why_watch: Exchange inflows and outflows are commonly watched because they can change liquidity questions.
watchlist_review_queue.report_use: Useful for explaining exchange in/out context while avoiding a trade recommendation.

watchlist_review_queue.source_class: public explorer label, protocol dashboard, or governance disclosure
watchlist_review_queue.why_watch: Bridge, treasury, and protocol movements can raise routing and concentration questions.
watchlist_review_queue.report_use: Useful AML-learning context for routing, consolidation, and cross-chain movement features.

report_records.public_source: Public explorer label or official public disclosure, to be cited before publication

report_records.title: Report 002: Public label before movement claim
report_records.address_or_label: Ethereum Foundation public treasury label candidate, full address still withheld on the public page until the source trail is reviewed
report_records.public_source: Public explorer label or official foundation disclosure must be cited before any movement row is published
report_records.what_moved: No movement claim in this record. The report records the label-review step before any transfer, balance, or exchange-flow interpretation.
report_records.timing: Prepared after source review so the wallet-watch lane starts with source quality rather than market meaning.
report_records.why_people_watch: Public treasury-style labels are watched because large balances and visible flows can change market questions, but the label alone does not explain intent.
report_records.aml_review_question: If a cited public label later shows repeated exchange, bridge, consolidation, or counterparty patterns, what source-backed question should a human reviewer ask first?
report_records.missing_context: Private ownership details, intent, off-chain reason, full history, counterparty purpose, and whether any movement relates to a trade.
report_records.clear_limit: Educational source-review record only. No advice, no accusation, no copied trade, no wallet control, no external submission, and no third-party account actions.
report_records.next_step: Verify one public label/source pair, then publish only the source trail and movement category that can be cited.

report_records.title: Report 003: EthDev explorer label and contract-call activity
report_records.public_source: Blockscout Ethereum address page labels the address as EthDev and Ethereum Foundation; Etherscan search result also returns EthDev for the same address.
report_records.source_snapshot: Blockscout page read: Contract details, EthDev, Ethereum Foundation, address 0xde0B295669a9FD93d5F28D9Ec85E40f4cb697BAe, balance shown as 9,774.4523225 ETH, 3,237 transactions, 8,376,156 transfers, last balance update 25198264.
report_records.what_moved: Movement category: contract-call / treasury-administration activity. Latest observed rows in the public Blockscout transaction API included successful isOwner and execute calls with zero ETH value, plus one small failed inbound transaction marked out of gas. This is a source-category record, not a market signal.
report_records.timing: Observed during the first source-cited report pass on 2026-05-28. The latest public API rows were dated 2026-05-25 and 2026-05-10.
report_records.why_people_watch: Known public foundation or treasury-style labels are watched because large balances and administrative calls can raise questions about treasury operations, counterparty patterns, or routing. The label and calls do not explain intent by themselves.
report_records.aml_review_question: When a known public foundation-label address shows administrative calls or repeated counterparties, is the useful review question about treasury operations, counterparty concentration, routing pattern, or simply a normal contract-management event?
report_records.missing_context: Intent, signer policy, off-chain reason, internal treasury process, counterparty purpose, whether a call changed balances internally, and whether the activity relates to any trade or market event.
report_records.clear_limit: Educational source-cited public-address record only. No advice, no accusation, no copied trade, no wallet control, no external submission, and no third-party account actions.
report_records.next_step: For the next report, choose an exchange hot-wallet label or protocol treasury label only after the explorer label and movement category can be cited with the same source-first discipline.
